meaning.head.yaw: + turns the face toward the character's left (screen right) (ParamAngleX; head.x +0.078 over its range)
meaning.head.pitch: + looks up (ParamAngleY; head.y +0.057 over its range)
meaning.head.tilt: + tilts the head counter-clockwise as seen, like head.roll (-ParamAngleZ; head.roll -20.000 over its range)
meaning.torso.yaw: + turns the upper body toward the character's left (ParamBodyAngleX; head.x +0.040 over its range)
meaning.torso.pitch: + leans back (head rises); - leans in (ParamBodyAngleY; head.y +0.080 over its range)
meaning.torso.tilt: + tilts the upper body counter-clockwise as seen (-ParamBodyAngleZ; head.roll -8.419 over its range)
